item.stem:
The diagram shows a net of a cuboid with edges 6 cm, 4 cm and 3 cm. An ant crawls on the surface from corner $A$ to corner $G$.

Which claim correctly identifies a shortest surface path?

options.A: On the net that joins a 6-by-4 face to a 6-by-3 face, the straight $A$-to-$G$ segment has length $\sqrt{6^{2}+7^{2}}=\sqrt{85}$ cm and is shortest among the three face-pair unfolds.
options.B: The shortest surface path is $\sqrt{6^{2}+4^{2}+3^{2}}$ cm, the interior space diagonal.
options.C: Adding $6+4+3$ gives the shortest surface path.
options.D: The unfold with length $\sqrt{109}$ cm is shortest because that net covers more area.
